title: Evolution Part One: Natural Selection and Extinction
heading: Evolution Part One: Natural Selection and Extinction
supportSummary: Natural selection explains why some variants persist under environmental pressure while others disappear.
Extinction is part of the same logic because systems that cannot fit changing conditions fail to survive.
Strong judgment pays attention to environmental fit rather than assuming strength in the abstract is enough.
